description: This file defines a function to build various SmartView objects with specific predicates based on filtering options, including predicates for notes, files, archived, trashed, untagged, and starred notes.

methods.name: BuildSmartViews
methods.description: Constructs an array of SmartView objects with predicates tailored to different note and file filters based on provided options.

methods.name: allNotesPredicate
methods.description: Creates a compound predicate for all notes, filtering out trashed, archived, protected, and pinned notes based on options.

methods.name: filesPredicate
methods.description: Creates a predicate for files, filtering based on trashed, archived, protected, and pinned status.

methods.name: archivedNotesPredicate
methods.description: Creates a predicate for archived notes, with optional filters for trashed, protected, and pinned notes.

methods.name: trashedNotesPredicate
methods.description: Creates a predicate for trashed notes, with optional filters for archived, protected, and pinned notes.

methods.name: untaggedNotesPredicate
methods.description: Creates a predicate for untagged notes, filtering out archived, protected, and pinned notes.

methods.name: starredNotesPredicate
methods.description: Creates a predicate for starred notes, with filters for trashed, protected, and pinned notes.
